videos.name: birds_rizq_en
videos.title: Look at the Birds
videos.title_en: Worried About Rizq? Look at the Birds
videos.caption: They leave hungry and come back full, every single day 🕊️ Do your part and trust Allah with the rest. Comment Hasbiyallah 👇

sources.grade: hasan sahih (at-Tirmidhi); also Ibn Majah 4164, Ahmad
sources.wording: English per the translation at abuaminaelias.com (narrated by Umar ibn al-Khattab); Arabic: taghdu khimasan wa taruhu bitanan

lines.text: Worried about your {rizq}? Look at the birds.
lines.text2: اپنے {رزق} کی فکر ہے؟ پرندوں کو دیکھیں۔
lines.say: Worried about your rizq? | Look at the birds.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:

lines.text: “If you were to {rely} upon Allah with reliance due to Him,
lines.text2: ”اگر تم اللہ پر ویسا {توکل} کرو جیسا اس کا حق ہے،
lines.say: If you were to *rely* upon Allah | with reliance due to Him,

lines.text: He would provide for you just as He provides for the {birds}.
lines.text2: تو وہ تمہیں ویسے ہی رزق دے جیسے {پرندوں} کو دیتا ہے۔
lines.say: He would provide for you, | just as He provides for the birds.

lines.text: They go out in the morning with {empty} stomachs
lines.say: They go out in the morning | with *empty* stomachs,

lines.text2: اور شام کو {پیٹ بھر کر} لوٹتے ہیں۔“

lines.text: The birds still {go out}. Do your part, and trust Allah with the rest.
lines.text2: پرندے پھر بھی {نکلتے} ہیں۔ اپنی کوشش کریں، باقی اللہ پر چھوڑ دیں۔
lines.say: The birds still go out. | Do your part, and trust Allah with the rest.

lines.label: Allah says
lines.text: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
lines.sub: “And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.” (At-Talaq 65:3)
lines.say: And whoever relies upon Allah, | then He is sufficient for him.

lines.text: Comment {Hasbiyallah} if you trust Him today.
lines.text2: اگر آج آپ اس پر بھروسہ کرتے ہیں تو {حسبی اللہ} لکھیں۔
lines.say: Comment Hasbiyallah | if you trust Him today.
